title: AI-Leveraged Full-Stack Developer (Next.js / React Native) - Build Web Apps and a Mobile App for a UK SaaS
description:
EQUALS3 builds software for the UK medical aesthetics sector. We have several web applications live or in build, plus a mobile app, and we work fast. Our entire build approach is AI-leveraged, with Claude as our primary tool. We are not looking for someone who codes the slow manual way. We are looking for someone who builds the way we do: AI as a force multiplier, shipping real features at pace.

This is the core loop of the role: you take a PRD, you build it, you report on progress clearly, and you tell us how it could have been specified or built better. The feedback half matters as much as the build half. We want a developer with the judgement to improve the work, not just execute it.

The actual job, day to day



Take a PRD and turn it into working, shipped software

Report on progress in clear written English: what is done, what is blocked, what changed and why

Give constructive feedback on the spec and the approach: where the PRD was unclear, where there is a better way to build it, what you would do differently next time

Build and maintain web applications in Next.js, React and TypeScript

Build and maintain our mobile app (React Native)

Wire up authentication (Clerk), payments (Stripe), and a Postgres database (Neon / Drizzle ORM)

Integrate external systems via APIs and webhooks, including our CRM (GoHighLevel)

Build AI-powered features using the Anthropic API through the Vercel AI SDK



Required



Strong Next.js, React and TypeScript

React Native or comparable mobile app experience

Fluent AI-assisted workflow. We use Claude; we have no preference on IDE, but you must be genuinely good at building with AI, not just occasionally prompting it

Solid Postgres experience; Drizzle ORM a plus

REST APIs and webhook integrations

Clean Git workflow

Excellent written English and the ability to work from a written brief without hand-holding

The judgement and confidence to push back on a spec when there is a better way



Nice to have



Stripe and Clerk experience

Experience building LLM / AI features in production

GoHighLevel familiarity

Rapid-build tooling (v0, Lovable)



Hours

Some overlap with UK working hours for calls and handovers. The rest is flexible.



How to apply



Start your application with the word CLINIC so I know you have read this properly.



Send a link to your GitHub or portfolio.



Describe, in a few sentences, one product you built from a spec: the stack, what it did, and one thing you would build differently if you did it again. The last part is the part I care about most.



Tell me how you actually use AI in your build process. Be specific.



Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid test task before any offer.

title: OJT - Vibe Coder - Remote
description:
Vibe Coder – Remote On-the-Job Training (OJT)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Duration: 6-month OJT (potential full-time conversion)

Hours: 40 hours/week

Stipend: TBD (open for discussion based on experience)

Updated: June 2026

THE ROLE

You'll be building the actual software that runs our ventures — and learning how real software gets shipped in a

live, fast-moving business environment.

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

automation pipelines. And someone needs to make them real.

That someone is you — but we'll teach you how.

What you'll actually do:

• Build real, shipped tools — not homework projects. CRM enrichment scripts, onboarding workflows,

recruiter dashboards, automation glue between Gmail/Sheets/Telegram/Slack. You'll see your code running in

production within weeks, not months.

• Learn by doing — We'll pair you with our team on live builds. You'll see what good code looks like (and what

bad code looks like). You'll learn when an AI is being helpful vs. when it's confidently wrong. You'll ship messy

v1s and iterate based on real feedback.

• Own the full loop — Spec (usually from a Slack message or voice note), build, deploy, iterate. We give

direction; you ship.

• Treat AI as a co-builder, not a crutch — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — these are your tools. You'll learn

to work with AI, not just at AI.

• Move fast — When someone says "what if we…", you'll prototype something demo-able in a day or two, not

request a Gantt chart.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need 5 years of experience. You need the right foundation and mindset.



Must-have:

? Technically capable — You've built something that ran. A side project. A class assignment you actually

finished. A startup idea you coded. It doesn't need to be polished; it needs to be real.

? AI-native — You think in AI. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily. You can articulate your actual

workflow (not "I sometimes use Copilot"). You're comfortable asking an LLM for code and know how to spot

when it's lying.

? Systems thinking — Either you're a CS/IT student or recent grad who understands databases, APIs, and

deployment, OR you're a business/entrepreneurship student who's built a venture or prototype and understands

how systems need to work to solve real problems.

? Hunger to ship — You get frustrated by endless meetings. You want to see your work in the world. You're

willing to learn in public.

? Communication — Half our briefs come as voice notes. You're okay with ambiguity and can ask clarifying

questions without needing a 30-page spec.



Nice to have:

? You've built something with Claude Code or Cursor and can talk about what worked/didn't

? You're comfortable with: Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node, Supabase, Vercel

? You've touched:
 bots, Gmail/Drive APIs, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier)

? You understand business tools: CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive), recruiting ops, or SME workflows

? You're based in the Philippines and understand SEA or Australian SME operations



THE OJT ADVANTAGE

This isn't a typical internship. You're not making coffee or organizing files.

? You'll ship real code to real users within your first month

? You'll learn modern development the way it's actually done in 2026 — with AI as a first-class teammate

? You'll work across the full stack — no "frontend only" silos; you'll touch API design, database schemas,

deployment, customer feedback loops

? You'll build a portfolio of deployed projects you can show future employers

? You'll earn a stipend (negotiable) + potential full-time offer at the end if it's a good fit

? You'll be paid for your time — not exploited as free labor

HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. A short note (200 words max) on:

• The most interesting thing you've built (could be a hackathon project, class assignment, side project, startup

idea)

• What it does

• What tools you used (especially if you used AI)

• What you'd do differently if you built it again

2. Show your work:

• GitHub links (even half-finished projects)

• Deployed apps or links to live projects

• Screenshots, demo videos, or Loom walkthroughs

• If you built something with Claude Code or Cursor, please include it

3. Optional but encouraged (60–90 minutes):

Pick one and build it using Claude Code, Cursor, or your favorite AI-native tool. Don't polish it. Send us the

messy version + a 2-minute Loom walkthrough explaining what you built and what you'd change.

 generator (upload contacts ? generate personalized drafts)

Option B: A
 bot that logs voice notes into a Google Sheet with auto-generated summaries

Option C: A mini dashboard that pulls from a public API (weather, crypto prices, GitHub repos, whatever) and

displays something useful





Send your code + Loom to:

title: Sports card business
description:
WAX & WEALTH — Part-Time Virtual Assistant

Sports Card Business | OnlineJobs.ph

ABOUT WAX & WEALTH

Wax & Wealth is a data-driven sports card business built around 2026 Bowman Chrome baseball cards. We run a proprietary Heat Index system (bowman-heat-index.pplx.app) that scores and ranks the top 50 prospects by grading opportunity — updated weekly, fully automated. The business generates revenue through a YouTube channel (3 videos/week), a free newsletter on Beehiiv that converts to a paid subscription at $12/month, and a growing community of card collectors who rely on our data to make smarter grading decisions. The system is built. We need someone sharp to run it.

---

AT A GLANCE

Type: Part-time, remote

Hours: ~20 hours/week

Pay: $400–$600/month (paid weekly via PayPal or Wise)

Schedule: Flexible — key deadlines Mon/Wed/Thu/Sat

---

THE ROLE

This is an execution role, not a strategy role. The system auto-generates scripts, alerts, and data every week. Your job is to take those outputs and publish them correctly and on schedule. You will follow clear weekly workflows — no guessing, no improvising required.

---

WHAT YOU’LL DO

1. CONTENT PRODUCTION — YouTube (3 videos/week)

• Every Monday, 3 complete video scripts are auto-generated and sent to you

• Review each script, format the YouTube description copy, add tags and thumbnail

• Upload to YouTube Studio on schedule: Short (Tuesday), Deep Dive (Thursday), Wildcard (Saturday)

• Pull the 3 most recent eBay sold comps for the featured prospect each week (base PSA 10 autos only — no parallels/refractors, search strings provided)

• Grade each video: Good / Needs Fix / Best of Week + one-line reason. Jeff reviews before anything goes live.

1. NEWSLETTER — Beehiiv (twice weekly)

• Wednesday: Build and schedule the free scorecard issue — top 5 prospects, basic data, CTA to paid tier

• Monday: Build and schedule the paid subscriber alert — PSA 10 spread data, full 50-prospect scorecard

• Both issues are built from the weekly data sheet using exact templates already provided

• Manage any subscriber reply questions as they come in

1. MARKETPLACE RESEARCH — eBay

• Weekly eBay comp pulls for the 3 featured prospects

• Base auto PSA 10 only — all parallels and refractors excluded (search strings provided)

• Record sale price and date for the 3 most recent sales

• Log results into a shared Google Sheet (format provided)

---

TOOLS

Required experience (you must know these before Day 1):

• Beehiiv — newsletter building and scheduling

• YouTube Studio — upload, descriptions, tags, thumbnails

• eBay — sold listings research

• Google Sheets — data entry and tracking

• Canva — basic thumbnail creation (templates provided)

You will be trained on Day 1:

• Bowman Chrome Heat Index dashboard (custom internal tool — easy to learn)

• Weekly signal sheet (Google Sheets template provided)

---

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

• The system is fully built — you execute, not build

• Scripts are auto-generated every Monday — zero writing required

• All templates provided: newsletter, thumbnails, upload checklist

• Clear weekly rhythm with firm deadlines — no ambiguity

• Owner reviews all content before it goes live — you’re never left hanging

• Stable, growing business with real revenue and a long-term outlook

• Growth potential as the channel and subscriber base scale

---

HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the phrase “Heat Index” at the top of your message — applications that don’t include this phrase will not be reviewed.

Answer this question in your message:

“What does PSA 10 mean and why does it matter for card value?”

Also include your relevant experience with Beehiiv, YouTube Studio, Canva, Google Sheets, and eBay research.

---

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) Sourcing & Sales Tracking Specialist
description:
We are a growing Amazon e-commerce company looking for an experienced, highly analytical, and data-driven Online Arbitrage (OA) Sourcing Virtual Assistant.



Your primary responsibility will be to find highly profitable products from online retail stores and marketplaces that we can flip on Amazon. Additionally, you will be responsible for daily data entry, managing spreadsheets to track our ongoing sales, calculating exact profit margins, and monitoring inventory levels.



If you love digging into data, are a master at spreadsheet formulas, and know how to find winning OA products, we want to talk to you!



Key Responsibilities:

Online Arbitrage Sourcing: Actively find profitable deals using manual sourcing methods and automated scanning tools across various US retail websites.



Keepa & Data Analysis: Analyze Keepa charts deeply to check sales velocity, buy box history, price stability, and competitor stock levels to ensure low-risk purchasing.



Sales & Profit Tracking: Maintain and meticulously update daily spreadsheets tracking units sold, gross sales, Amazon fees, cost of goods sold (COGS), and net profit.



Inventory & Buy Box Monitoring: Keep track of existing inventory levels, alert us when items need restocking, and monitor our active listings for competitive pricing changes.



IP & Restriction Verification: Confirm that products are not gated and have no history of Intellectual Property (IP) complaints or brand restrictions.



Strict Data Security & Confidentiality (Non-Negotiable):

?? Zero-Tolerance Policy: All product leads, sourcing strategies, daily sales data, and spreadsheet access are strictly confidential and the exclusive property of our company. Sharing any of our spreadsheets, tracking links, or product leads with other VAs, external networks, or third parties is strictly prohibited. Any violation of this policy is a breach of trust and constitutes grounds for immediate dismissal without warning.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience specifically in Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) sourcing and e-commerce tracking.



Tools: Highly proficient with Keepa, Seller Central, and OA sourcing tools (e.g., Tactical Arbitrage, Source Mogul, or SellerAmp SAS).



Spreadsheet Expert: Advanced skills in Google Sheets and MS Excel. You must be comfortable working with formulas, filtering massive amounts of data, and keeping tracking sheets perfectly organized.



Hardware & Technical Setup:



Computer: A modern, fast computer with at least 8GB of RAM (16GB preferred) that can handle multiple active browser extensions and massive data sheets without lagging.



Internet: A stable, high-speed wired internet connection (DSL, Cable, or Fiber) with a minimum speed of 20 Mbps. Note: Mobile hotspots/satellite internet are not accepted due to reliability concerns.



Backup: A reliable backup plan for internet/power outages to ensure daily sales tracking is never missed.



What We Offer:

Competitive salary based on experience (paid weekly).



Performance-based bonuses tied directly to the profitability of your product finds.



Clear guidelines, structured workflows, and a supportive working environment.



Full-time, long-term career growth potential.



How to Apply:

To apply, please reply to this post with the subject line: "I am your next OA Sourcing & Tracking Expert - [Your Name]" and include the following:



A brief summary of your experience sourcing for Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA).



Which specific OA tools and browser extensions you use daily.



A screenshot of a Keepa chart you analyzed recently, with a 2-sentence explanation of why it is a winning OA product.



A brief description of your current work setup (PC specs, internet provider, and connection speed).



Confirm that you have read and agree to our strict Zero-Tolerance data security policy regarding tracking sheets and leads.



Your desired monthly salary for a full-time position.



Applications missing the correct subject line or any of the requested answers will be automatically disqualified.

title: Video Editor
description:
Hi! I'm looking for a video editor to work with on an ongoing basis. To start, I'll have around 5–10 videos a week, and if it's a good fit there's room for a lot more — this is meant to be a long-term, regular gig, not a one-off.



The videos are for instagram reels, they will be between 30sec-2min long. 



The work is consistent and the style is repeatable (you'll see exactly what I'm after in the brief and inspiration links below), so once you've got the workflow down it should be quick to turn around.



Rate: $5



If this sounds good, send me a couple of examples of similar editing you've done — short-form, split-screen, or talking-head/captioned content. 



I want you to do a sample video for me so I can assess your skill level and see if you align with my brand. 



Editor sample brief 



Footage: Two synced angles of the same take — a front camera on my face, and an overhead camera looking down at the whiteboard in my hands.



Deliverable: One video, Instagram Reels format (9:16 vertical, 1080×1920).



Content - 



Inspiration 1 - 



Inspiration 2 - 



Layout — split screen: Copy inspiration exactly. 



The main job — picking the best take: For each section I often did multiple takes. I'd stumble, stop, and restart the same line. As a rule of thumb, the last complete take of a section is usually the best one — default to that. 



Cut everything before it: false starts, restarts, repeated lines, dead air. If an earlier take is clearly cleaner, use your judgment, but when in doubt, use the last full attempt. The goal is for every section to sound like I said it once, smoothly.



Keep both angles in sync: Every time you cut something out, cut both cameras at the same point so the face cam and the overhead stay lined up. Never tighten one angle and let the other drift.



Editing style: Smooth and clean — no crazy transitions or flashy effects. The only effect I want is a small, subtle zoom on the hook (first few seconds) to grab attention.



Audio: Use the face camera as the audio source.



Captions: Burned-in subtitles, styled exactly like the inspiration — same font, size, placement, and animation.



If in doubt, copy the inspiration. 



Once complete, please send me your sample videos in a google drive link. 



Best of luck!

Nick

title: Senior Bookkeeper & Finance Operations Manager (Remote)
description:
# Senior Bookkeeper & Finance Operations Manager (Remote)



## Help Build One of Africa's Most Innovative Health Companies



We are a growing healthcare group operating in East Africa, with established chiropractic clinics and an expanding digital health platform. Our mission is to help individuals, families, and companies take control of their health through preventative care, functional medicine, diagnostics, and technology.



We are looking for an exceptional **Senior Bookkeeper & Finance Operations Manager** who can bring structure, clarity, and financial discipline to a fast-growing business.



This is not a basic bookkeeping role.



We need someone who can help build a finance system that gives leadership real-time visibility into cash flow, profitability, growth, and business performance.



---



## Your Mission



Your primary responsibility will be to create financial clarity for the founder and leadership team.



You will ensure all financial records are accurate, up-to-date, and transformed into simple dashboards that allow quick and confident decision-making.



You will become the central hub for financial reporting, cash flow visibility, and operational finance.



---



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### Bookkeeping & Financial Management



* Daily bookkeeping and transaction management

* Bank reconciliations across multiple accounts

* Accounts payable management

* Accounts receivable management

* Expense tracking and categorization

* Monthly financial close

* Maintaining accurate financial records

* Managing multi-currency transactions



### Reporting & Dashboards



Create and maintain weekly and monthly reports including:



* Revenue

* Profitability

* Cash balances

* Cash flow forecasts

* Outstanding receivables

* Outstanding payables

* Budget vs actual performance

* Key business metrics



The goal is to provide leadership with a simple dashboard that answers:



* How much cash do we have?

* How much did we earn?

* What bills are coming due?

* Are we growing?

* What needs attention?



### Systems & Automation



You will be expected to:



* Implement and maintain Xero

* Manage receipt capture systems

* Automate repetitive financial processes

* Improve financial workflows

* Reduce manual data entry

* Create scalable systems that support business growth



### Coordination & Compliance



* Work with local accountants and tax advisors

* Prepare information needed for tax filings

* Monitor financial deadlines

* Ensure records remain organized and audit-ready



---



## Required Experience



### Must Have



* Minimum 5 years bookkeeping experience

* Advanced Xero experience (preferred)

* QuickBooks Online experience accepted

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Experience managing multiple accounts and business entities

* Strong understanding of bookkeeping fundamentals

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Ability to work independently



### Strongly Preferred



* Xero Certification

* Experience supporting healthcare businesses

* Experience supporting founders or entrepreneurs

* Experience creating management dashboards

* Experience with automation tools

* Multi-currency accounting experience



---



## The Person We're Looking For



You are:



* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* Proactive

* Trustworthy

* Reliable

* Technology-savvy

* Process-driven

* Comfortable working remotely

* Able to solve problems without constant supervision



Most importantly, you enjoy turning financial chaos into financial clarity.



---



## Success in This Role Looks Like



Within 90 days:



* All accounts fully reconciled

* Weekly founder dashboard implemented

* Cash flow forecast operating

* Reporting delivered on time

* Financial records cleaned and organized

* Major manual finance tasks automated



Within 12 months:



* Finance systems operating smoothly

* Founder has complete visibility into finances

* Accurate monthly reporting delivered consistently

* Strong financial controls established

* Business prepared for significant growth



---



## Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow with a mission-driven healthcare company.



---



## Application Instructions



Please submit:



### Required



1. Updated CV/Resume

2. Cover Letter

3. Three Professional References



### Include the Following



1. What accounting software you have used

### Video Introduction



Please include a **3–5 minute Loom video** answering:

 your application to:

**Senior Bookkeeper & Finance Operations Manager Application – [Your Name]**



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Full Stack Developer - React Native / Expo / SpringBoot
description:
> Location:  Remote-friendly

---



1. The Challenge



We're looking for a developer who can move seamlessly between our React Native mobile app (Expo SDK 55, Zustand stores) and our Spring Boot microservices backend.



You won't just "touch both sides" - you'll own features end-to-end.



---



2. What You'll Actually Build



Mobile Side (Expo / React Native)



- MMKV persistence, and type-safe component registries, push notification router, Deeplink & URL Routing



Backend Side (Spring Boot / Java)



- REST API Design: Clean, versioned endpoints for the mobile app to consume

- Authentication & Security: OAuth2 flows, JWT validation.

- Scheduled jobs and SFTP reconciliation

- Firebase Cloud Messaging orchestration

- Data Layer: SQL Server with Hibernate, QueryDSL, Liquibase migrations, JOIN FETCH optimization



---



3. Tech Stack



Mobile Stack



Framework: Expo SDK 55, React Native 0.83, React 19.2



Language: TypeScript 5.9 (strict mode)



Navigation: Expo Router (file-based)



State: Zustand 4.5, TanStack Query 5.50



HTTP: Axios 1.7 + custom fetch wrapper



Forms: React Hook Form + Yup/Zod



Storage: MMKV, AsyncStorage, expo-secure-store



Maps: react-native-maps 1.27, clustering




 23.5



Backend Stack



Language: Java 17



Framework: Spring Boot 2.7, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, WebFlux



Persistence: SQL Server (Azure), Hibernate, QueryDSL, Liquibase



Security: OAuth2, JWT



Messaging: Firebase Cloud Messaging, SendGrid



Resilience: Resilience4j (Circuit Breaker)



Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito, Jacoco



---



4. Must-Have Requirements



Hard Requirements



Equipment:



- Mac computer (MacBook, Mac mini, or iMac) required for iOS app development and compilation



Mobile Expertise:



- 3+ years professional React Native with at least 1 year on Expo (managed + bare workflows)

- Deep TypeScript fluency , discriminated unions, mapped types, strict generics

- Production Zustand + TanStack Query experience

- Native module debugging, reading iOS/Android crash logs

- Push notification architecture, Expo Notifications, FCM, iOS/Android payload differences



Backend Expertise:



- 3+ years professional Java backend development

- Strong Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA

- SQL proficiency, query optimization, indexing, JOIN FETCH, avoiding N+1

- REST API design, versioning, pagination, HTTP semantics, OpenAPI

- OAuth2/JWT, flows, token lifecycle, refresh strategies



Full Stack Judgment:



- Experience designing APIs you later consumed (or vice versa)

- Understanding of mobile-backend contract design: what to cache, what to paginate, how to handle offline scenarios

- Debugging distributed features (logs, correlation IDs, network inspection)



Critical Soft Skills



- Reads code before writing it,  The mobile codebase has 30+ stores; the backend has 100+ service interfaces. You trace data flow before proposing changes.

- End-to-end ownership,  You don't hand off "backend work" or "frontend work." You ship the feature.



---



5. Nice-to-Have (Separates Good from Great)



- Firebase expertise,  Analytics funnels, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging

- Open-source contributions to Expo, React Native, Spring Boot



---



6. What You Won't Do



- ? Use Expo Go. We use development builds with custom native modules

- ? Ignore the database. You'll write and optimize SQL

- ? Skip tests. JUnit + Jacoco on backend



---



7. Interview Process



Technical Test.  We look for evidence of mobile depth

About the Role



You will be editing short-form video content for social media, ads, and brand marketing. We want someone who can take raw footage and turn it into high-quality content that feels professional, engaging, and visually clean.



We have high standards for the finished product. The work should not look rushed, generic, or amateur. Every video should feel polished before it is submitted.

We expect strong attention to detail. Text should be placed correctly, effects should feel smooth, audio should be clean, and the overall edit should have a professional finish.



We are looking for someone who understands that small details matter. Poor timing, messy captions, bad transitions, weak visuals, or unfinished-looking edits will not work for this role.



Requirements



Strong experience editing high-quality short-form content

You are not open to feedback or revisions



You cannot meet deadlines consistently

**Title:**

Video Editor for Cinematic Football Storytelling Channel (Long-Form, 5-10 min)



**Description:**



I run a football YouTube channel and need an experienced editor for long-form videos (5-10 minutes) in a cinematic, narrative documentary style — think the "He Knew" / prophecy-style football essay videos (examples attached: WINTHLETIC channel, your portfolio piece in this style).



This is a potential long-term role if it's a good fit — looking for someone who wants ongoing work, not a one-off.



**Must have:**

- Strong football knowledge — you need to understand players, storylines, and context well enough to make editing decisions that fit the narrative, not just cut to a script blindly

- Experience finding and sourcing clips (archive, match footage, stock) and know how to avoid copyright strikes/claims when using footage

- Experience writing/styling captions

- A track record of editing for retention — strong pacing, knowing where viewers drop off, and how to structure cuts to keep people watching longer



**Style requirements:**

- Dark, moody, desaturated colour grade — not bright highlight-reel editing

- Voiceover-led pacing: cuts follow the script's rhythm, not just matched to match footage

- Strong cold open in the first 5-10 seconds

- Mix of archive/talking-head clips, match footage, and slow-motion cutaways for emphasis

- Sparse on-screen text — used only for key stats/phrases, not full captions

- Dramatic, minimal-build instrumental score with sound design hits (whooshes, impacts) on key beats

- Thumbnail design included: split-portrait composition, dramatic lighting, bold 2-3 word hook text (reference attached)



**What I need from you:**

- Sourcing clips/footage (copyright-safe)

- Full edit: cut, colour grade, sound design, music, captions

- Retention-focused pacing throughout

- 1 YouTube thumbnail per video

- Format: 16:9, 1080p or 4K



**To apply, please include:**

1. Your most relevant long-form portfolio piece

2. Confirmation of your football knowledge (favourite leagues/teams you follow, or experience editing football content before)

3. Your typical turnaround time for a 5-10 min edit

title: Sales & Event Operations
description:
About Optimal AI

Optimal AI is building the quality and judgment layer for AI generated code.



Optibot, our first multi-agent system, serves as thoughtful code review agents that flag issues line by line, and fix them. Optibot identifies security vulnerabilities, technical debt, and compliance risks with full codebase context, while cutting PR cycle times and improving engineering velocity. Paired with our Engineering Insights Platform, teams get real-time analytics on code quality and productivity across every repo.



We're trusted by engineering teams at Bear Robotics, LG, MongoDB, MPulse, Prometric, and more. Backed by Act One ventures and Chingona Ventures, with a team of serial exited entrepreneurs, YCombinator, McKinsey and Boeing alums.



The Role



We're building out our events and GTM engine and we need a sharp, creative operator to own it. You'll be responsible for making sure our events, engineering leader dinners, virtual shows, and community gatherings are consistently full, high-quality, and running like clockwork. You'll also support our outbound pipeline with lead research, copywriting, videos and campaign execution. You will be expected to work Pacific hours, synced with our San Francisco HQ.



This role sits at the intersection of events, sales ops, and video content. If you love building systems, writing copy that converts, and making things look great, this is your seat.



How we work



? High ownership, high output. Everyone on the team owns outcomes end-to-end. We work best with individuals who are precise, fast, and great at unblocking themselves.

? Critical feedback is a gift. We give feedback directly and receive it without ego. Don't take it personally. It's how we get better.

? Customer-obsessed. We make an effort to talk to all our customers and relentlessly provide value to each of them.



What You'll Do



Events



1. Collaborate on end-to-end logistics for our dinner series and virtual events like venue coordination, getting guest lists sorted, RSVPs, run of show, name tags, and day-of execution.

2. Use Clay, Heyreach, Instantly, Luma and other lead generation tools to build targeted invite lists and fill rooms consistently.

3. Write outreach copy and event messaging that gets people to show up.

4. Cold calling event attendees to confirm attendance and get pre calls booked



Content & Design



- Edit video content for LinkedIn, YouTube, and event recaps using CapCut, Descript, Premiere Pro or any video editor to produce high quality content…

- Create high-quality graphics, social assets, and event visuals using Canva, Gemini’s Nano Banana, and other AI tools.

- Write copy for campaigns, event invites, LinkedIn posts, and Instantly/Heyreach outbound sequences.



Sales & Pipeline Support



- Build lead lists and prospect using Clay, Evaboot and similar tools

- Do lead research of deals in our pipeline that we would like to multithread into by finding other champions and mapping out the org and their pains using tools like Sales Navigator and AI like Claude.

- Answering/replying to messages and
s from campaigns we are running in Heyreach and Instantly with the goal of getting demos booked in the calendar. 

- Support outbound campaigns across
 and LinkedIn (managing sequences, tracking performance, flagging what's working)

- Keep the CRM clean by updating records, flagging follow-ups, tracking pipeline activity



What We're Looking For

- 1–3 years in events, sales ops, marketing coordination, or a similar fast-paced role

- Hands-on experience with Clay or similar lead gen/data enrichment tools

- Video editing skills with CapCut, Descript, Premiere pro, or similar

- Highly organized, proactive, and able to juggle multiple events and campaigns at once

- Startup experience or comfort with ambiguity is a strong plus

s from campaigns we are running in Heyreach and Instantly with the goal of getting demos booked in the calendar.

title: Reddit Operations Manager
description:
We are hiring a Reddit Operations Manager for an online social media agency.



This is not a basic posting role.



Posting is only one part of the operation. We need someone who can take ownership of the full Reddit system: content, accounts, subreddit strategy, team management, tracking, analysis, testing, and performance improvement.



You will be responsible for managing Reddit posters underneath you, but your main value is strategic thinking, organisation, problem-solving, and improving the operation.



Main Responsibilities

Manage the full Reddit operation across multiple models and accounts

Manage Reddit posters and review their daily output

Assign posting tasks clearly and make sure work is completed properly

Request new content from managers/models based on what is needed for Reddit

Review content in detail and give clear feedback on what needs to improve

Research winning content styles, titles, angles, and subreddit trends

Build and improve subreddit posting lists based on niche, branding, rules, audience fit, engagement quality, and removal risk

Analyse subreddit performance and d
 which communities to keep, test, remove, or scale

Develop strategic direction for each model’s Reddit positioning

Track post performance, removals, account issues, engagement, clicks, and next actions

Diagnose Reddit filter/removal issues and create solutions



What We Need

We need someone who thinks like a manager, not just a poster.

You should be able to look at the Reddit operation and think:



What content do we need more of?

Which subreddits actually fit this model?

Which posts are getting reach but no buyers?

Which accounts are being wasted?

Which posters are making mistakes?

What needs to change tomorrow?

What tests should we run next?



If there is a problem, we do not want you to only say:



“Posts are being removed.”



We want you to say:



“The posts are being removed because of X. I have already tested Y, I am currently implementing Z, and if that does not work, this is the backup plan.”



You must come with solutions, not just problems.



Requirements

Strong understanding of Reddit

Experience with Reddit posting, subreddit research, or Reddit account management

Experience managing posters, VAs, or a small team

Strong English writing and communication skills

Strong attention to detail

Able to analyse content, branding, captions, and subreddit fit

Able to research competitors and identify what is working

Able to think strategically and make data-led decisions

Able to give clear feedback and hold people accountable

Able to create daily reports and weekly improvement plans

Able to work independently and take ownership



Important

This role requires focus. Do not apply if you are already juggling too many jobs and cannot properly commit to the role.

We are looking for someone who wants long-term work and can grow into a key management position.



Please complete this form to apply -

title: Virtual Assisstant
description:
Company: Ottawa Prime Properties

Location: Remote

Languages: English and French

Job Type: Full-time or Part-time

About Ottawa Prime Properties

Ottawa Prime Properties is a growing property management company serving residential and commercial properties in Ontario and Quebec. We are looking for a highly organized, bilingual Virtual Assistant with property management experience to support our daily operations, tenant communication, maintenance coordination, leasing administration, and owner/client reporting.

Position Overview

The Bilingual Virtual Assistant will provide administrative and operational support to the property management team. The ideal candidate must be fluent in English and French, have strong communication skills, and understand property management procedures in both Ontario and Quebec, including tenant notices, leases, rent collection, maintenance follow-ups, and documentation.

Experience with Ontario’s Landlord and Tenant Board processes and Quebec’s Tribunal administratif du logement procedures is a strong asset, especially for preparing notices, tracking files, and supporting landlord-tenant documentation. The TAL handles lease-related matters such as rent increases, repossessions, and landlord/tenant disputes, while Ontario’s Residential Tenancies Act provides the framework for residential tenancies, including rent increases and evictions.

Key Responsibilities

The Bilingual Virtual Assistant will be responsible for:

Managing daily
 communication with tenants, owners, contractors, and team members in both English and French.

Answering tenant inquiries professionally and escalating urgent matters to the property manager.

Coordinating maintenance requests, following up with contractors, requesting quotes, and updating tenants and owners.

Preparing and sending notices, letters, reminders, and property-related communications in English and French.

Assisting with lease administration, renewals, rent increase notices, tenant onboarding, and move-in/move-out coordination.

Updating property management software with tenant information, charges, maintenance notes, lease details, documents, and communication records.

Following up on unpaid rent, payment confirmations, utility bills, invoices, and owner-related accounting requests.

Organizing documents, invoices, quotes, inspection photos, reports, and property files.

Assisting with leasing tasks, including responding to rental inquiries, scheduling showings, screening applicants, collecting documents, and preparing lease files.

Tracking deadlines for renewals, notices, maintenance work, inspections, and tenant requests.

Supporting Ontario and Quebec property-management workflows, including LTB/TAL-related documents and timelines.

Preparing clear summaries and updates for management, owners, and internal meetings.

Required Qualifications

Fluent in English and French, written and spoken.

Previous experience as a virtual assistant, administrative assistant, property management assistant, or leasing coordinator.

Property management experience in Ontario and Quebec is strongly preferred.

Knowledge of residential leases, tenant notices, rent collection, maintenance coordination, and tenant communication.

Familiarity with Ontario LTB and Quebec TAL processes is a strong asset.

Strong writing skills and ability to prepare professional
s, notices, and reports.

Excellent organization, follow-up, and time-management skills.

Comfortable working remotely and independently.

Strong attention to detail and ability to document all communication properly.

Ability to handle tenant issues professionally and calmly.

Experience using property management software such as Buildium, AppFolio, DoorLoop, Yardi, or similar is an asset.

Proficient with Google Drive, Gmail, Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, and DocuSign.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is proactive, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and priorities at the same time. They must be able to communicate professionally with tenants, owners, contractors, and team members while keeping accurate records of every request and follow-up.

This person should understand that property management requires strong documentation, fast follow-up, and clear communication, especially when dealing with maintenance, rent collection, lease renewals, tenant complaints, and legal notices.

Work Schedule

Remote position.

Monday to Friday availability preferred.

Occasional urgent follow-ups may be required depending on tenant or maintenance issues.

Ontario and Quebec business-hour availability is preferred.

How to Apply

Please send your resume and a short message explaining your property management experience in Ontario and Quebec, your level of English and French, and any property management software you have used.

title: Project Reviewer
description:
Project Reviewer - Civil Site Design & Utilities 

Modern Engineering Solutions, LLC | Fully Remote - Global Opportunity 



You'll Be Perfect For This Role If: 

You're an engineering professional with 4-8 years of experience, and you're frustrated with how most firms handle quality control. Maybe you're tired of: 

? Being rushed through reviews to meet arbitrary deadlines 

? Finding the same mistakes repeatedly because no one learns from feedback 

? The "just get it approved" mentality that treats QA as an afterthought 

? Being stuck in an office when the work doesn't require it 

? Firms that talk about quality but punish thoroughness with tighter deadlines 



You want to work on projects that matter—commercial developments that shape how communities grow, utility systems that serve reliably for decades—and you want to do it right, without cutting corners. 



You're open to using modern tools (including AI) to streamline documentation, and you understand that protecting time for thorough review is how you catch problems before they become expensive failures. 



What We Believe 

Here's how we run things differently: 



? We Focus on Getting It Right, Not Getting It Done Fast 

Your value isn't how many plan sets you can rush through—it's the problems you catch before they reach clients or construction. A review that prevents a $200K construction error or catches a code violation before permit submittal? That's worth more than logging extra review hours. 



? Quality Can't Be Rushed 

We give reviewers the time they need to do thorough work. Time-to-delivery matters, but not at the expense of catching critical errors. We treat quality review as an engineering constraint, not an afterthought. 



? Deep Work Over Busy Work 

We protect your calendar. No back-to-back meetings. No "quick syncs" that break your concentration. Reviewers need uninterrupted time to systematically work through designs—that's where you catch the subtle problems that matter. 



? AI Handles the Grunt Work 

We use AI for formatting review comments, tracking standard items, and generating markup templates. You still do all the technical judgment and critical review—AI makes mistakes—but it frees you up to handle 10 projects instead of 2. 



? We Grow Carefully 

We're not chasing debt-fueled growth. We'd rather expand slowly with cash reserves so we can maintain quality standards and give reviewers adequate time for thorough work. 



? We Keep Learning 

"That's how we've always done it" isn't good enough. We're constantly refining our review processes, learning from mistakes, and getting better at catching problems early. 



What You'll Do 

Conduct systematic quality assurance reviews of civil site designs and utility infrastructure: 

? Review commercial site development plans including grading, drainage, paving, and utility layouts for technical accuracy and code compliance 

? Analyze plan sets, stormwater calculations, and hydraulic analyses to identify errors and improvement opportunities 

? Verify compliance with municipal design standards, state regulations, and local development criteria 

? Conduct constructability reviews to ensure designs can actually be built as intended 

? Prepare detailed review summaries with clear, actionable feedback 

? Work directly with Project Managers and Engineers to resolve technical issues 

? Review water, sewer, and stormwater system designs for functionality and compliance 

? Maintain and update quality control checklists and review procedures 

? Support permit application reviews to ensure regulatory compliance 

? Help junior engineers learn from review feedback to improve future designs 



What You Need 

Required: 

? Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field 

? 4-8 years in civil site design, commercial development, or project review 

? Strong understanding of site grading, drainage design, stormwater management, and utility systems 

? Knowledge of US municipal design standards, stormwater regulations, and development criteria 

? Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D for plan review and markup creation 

? Excellent English language skills for effective communication with US-based teams 

? Demonstrated attention to detail with systematic approach to identifying technical issues 

? Strong communication skills—you can explain technical problems clearly 



Preferred: 

? Experience with US-based commercial development projects 

? Familiarity with stormwater modeling software (Hydro CAD, Storm CAD, SSA) 

? Background in construction or field engineering 

? Track record of improving design quality through systematic review feedback 

? Understanding of plat preparation and subdivision design processes 



About Us  

Modern Engineering Solutions isn't another civil engineering firm stuck in the old ways.  



We built this company because we were tired of watching quality control get treated as a box to check instead of a critical safeguard. Tired of seeing reviewers rushed through projects just to hit billable hour targets. Tired of firms that say "quality matters" but don't give reviewers the time or tools to actually ensure it.  



Since 2018, we've completed 265+ projects by doing things differently. Our team works remotely, uses AI to handle the busywork, and focuses on what matters: delivering error-free site designs that protect communities and serve clients well. No unnecessary meetings. No office politics. Just thorough, systematic quality assurance. 



What We Offer 

Work Environment: 

? 100% remote work from anywhere with reliable internet 

? Flexible scheduling that accommodates your time zone 

? Training on our cloud-based systems and AI tools 

? Microsoft Teams for collaboration, SharePoint for document management 

? Top-tier hardware and software we don't cheap out on tools 



Compensation & Benefits: 

? Salary: $30,000–$45,000 annually (adjusted based on location and experience) 

? Professional development and mentorship opportunities 

? Support for technical training and skill development 

? Clear path to grow into senior review or technical leadership roles 



Leadership & Impact: 

? Work with experienced US-licensed PEs who value thorough review 

? Real input on improving our quality control processes 

? Help us prove there's a better way to ensure infrastructure quality 



Why This Matters 

Right now, most commercial development projects get reviewed just enough to avoid obvious disasters. Subtle design problems slip through. Code violations get caught by plan reviewers instead of internal QA. Construction errors cost clients hundreds of thousands because no one caught the conflicts in design. 



We're changing that. 

When you join us, you're proving that thorough quality assurance doesn't require sacrificing schedule or budget—it just requires giving reviewers the time and tools to do their job right. You're showing that systematic review processes catch problems early, when they're cheap to fix. 



From warehouse developments to mixed-use communities, your reviews will ensure infrastructure that works reliably for decades and you'll do it without burning out from impossible deadlines. 



This Role Isn't For Everyone 

We're probably not the right fit if you: 

? Want to rush through reviews to maximize throughput (we value thoroughness) 

? Think AI has no place in engineering (we use it extensively) 

? See QA as a box to check rather than a critical safeguard (we take it seriously) 

? Believe "that's how we've always done it" ends the discussion (we're constantly improving) 



But if you're tired of the old model and ready for something better—where quality actually matters more than speed, where modern tools eliminate busywork, and where working remotely doesn't limit your career—let's talk. 



How to Apply 

Send us three things: 

? Your resume showing your relevant civil site design and quality assurance experience 

? A brief cover letter explaining why this approach to quality control resonates with you 

? A 3-minute video describing your systematic approach to reviewing technical drawings and identifying potential design issues

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About the role



Cottonwood Acquisitions is a small-business operator group with nine portfolio companies across the US and Canada. We're hiring a remote senior accountant to lead day-to-day accounting across three of our businesses: Pacific Register (manufacturer of decorative HVAC registers, Oxnard CA USA), Total Restoration (restoration and mitigation services, Penticton BC Canada), and Marine Systems (manufacturer of decorative HVAC grilles and thermoformed components for yachts, Asheville, NC, USA).



This is a hands-on senior accounting role reporting directly to the CEO. The right hire takes pride in clean financial statements, accurate bank reconciliations, and well-supported audits. Initial scope is three entities.



What success looks like

The single most important outcome is to own the preparation of monthly financial statements and quarterly bank reporting. Within 90 days we want this hire owning the monthly close, producing clean GAAP-quality financial statements with management commentary, and serving as the day-to-day liaison with our external auditors at year-end.



Day-to-day responsibilities



Own the monthly close across three entities, hands-on. A representative slice of what this involves: bank reconciliations for cash, posting customer payments across credit card / PayPal / ACH channels, multi-state sales tax filings, full bank and credit card reconciliations, journal entries and accruals, intercompany allocations between US and Canadian entities, customer advance reclassifications, and AP/AR oversight.



Manage the bookkeepers at each of the businesses, coach them on how to improve processes and identify technology to streamline processes.



Prepare monthly three-statement financial packages (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement) with management commentary.



Calculate quarterly bank covenant compliance against existing credit agreements (DSCR, leverage ratios, fixed charge coverage, working capital tests).



Manage year-end external audit support across all three entities — prepare PBC schedules, respond to auditor requests, drive resolution of open items.



It will take some time to understand the businesses and we would like to see the candidate embark to understand the 3 businesses and build a FAQ document of the people at the businesses, what their roles are and what you learn about the businesses. Then when there are slower periods in the role, we would like to see the creation of process documentation to professionalize our accounting processes.



Must-haves



CPA equivalent license required

Experience having worked full time for an English speaking business in the past is required

6–12 years accounting experience, including ownership of monthly close

Strong written and spoken English

Multi-entity accounting experience

QuickBooks Desktop and Sage 50 Canada experience is helpful, but not required

US or Canadian SMB client experience preferred

Comfortable preparing three-statement financial packages independently

Hands-on orientation — "no task too small"



Strong nice-to-haves

Big 4 / SGV / SyCip background (audit experience preferred)

Manufacturing or services industry experience

Experience supporting acquisitions or year-end audits

Work setup



Fully remote with some Bridge overlap with USA Pacific Time.



Weekly check-in call. After the transition period, we expect ad hoc calls outside of the designated hours to be uncommon — typically no more than 1–2 per week, often less.
 and Messages for everything else.



Camera-on during calls.



Ideal candidate profile



The person who's right for this role is a mature senior accountant who takes pride in precision work and clean books. They've outgrown their current seat at a local firm or BPO client and want a longer-term home with a growing US business. They love a clean reconciliation. They write well in English. They're comfortable being the most senior accountant on the team but unbothered by hands-on detail work — they understand that a clean balance sheet doesn't reconcile itself.



They are looking for a stable, dignified, longer-term role where their craft is valued and the work is interesting enough to grow into.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Operations Manager (Virtual Assistant)



Paradise Auto Care | Remote | Full-Time | US Pacific Time Hours





WHAT THIS IS



Paradise Auto Care is a premium mobile detailing and vehicle protection studio based in Lake Elsinore, California. We serve high-value clients across the Temecula Valley who trust us with some of their most prized possessions.



This is not a task list job.



This is a role for someone who will become the operational backbone of a growing business — managing client communications, running our CRM, building our systems in Notion, posting content daily across multiple social media platforms, and editing short-form video content for two brands.



If you want easy work, this is not it.

If you want ownership, growth, and a business that invests in people who perform — keep reading.





ROLE SUMMARY



The Operations & Client Experience Manager is a full-ownership remote role responsible for running the back end of Paradise Auto Care and supporting the CEO Paradise personal brand.



This is not a support role. This is an execution role.



You will respond to leads, manage our CRM pipeline, own our Notion workspace, post daily to all social media platforms, and edit short-form video content using CapCut — across two brands.



While the owner focuses on sales and service delivery, you make sure everything else runs.





SCHEDULE & PAY





Hours: 6 hours/day | 5 days/week | 30 hours/week

Starting pay: $30/day

Pay schedule: Weekly via Wise

Hours: Must be available during US Pacific Time business hours

Raises: 30 / 60 / 90-day performance milestones — clearly defined

Bonuses: Available for complex projects and skill growth

Growth: Editing skill development leads to direct pay increases







CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Lead Response & Call Setting — Priority #1





-Respond to every new inbound lead within 5 minutes — no exceptions

-Follow our Call Setter SOP — book a sales call with Mike, do not give pricing

-Manage the full CRM pipeline in GoHighLevel / LeadFuse daily

-Run follow-up sequences for every non-responsive lead through all pipeline stages

-Handle Instagram DMs,
 messages, and all inbound inquiries

-Confirm and remind clients of all scheduled appointments





Scheduling & Calendar Management





-Fully manage the owner's Urable calendar

-Offer two accurate time windows per booking — always cross-check calendar first

-Handle reschedules, cancellations, and day-of confirmations





CRM & Tool Mastery





-Keep GoHighLevel / LeadFuse pipeline clean, tagged, and moving daily

-Audit and build GHL automations and workflows

-Watch all Urable tutorial videos — find and implement unused features

-Report weekly on tool improvements made and features discovered





Notion — Company Operating System





-Build our entire Notion workspace from scratch in collaboration with the owner

-Import and format all existing SOPs into Notion

-Build technician checklists, content calendars, KPI dashboards, and hiring pipelines

-Document every process learned as a clean, usable SOP

-Maintain and update SOPs as the business evolves





Google Business Profile





-Post 4–5+ times per week following our SEO SOP

-Rename all photo files using our SEO naming formula before uploading

-Pull monthly GBP performance report





Social Media — Paradise Auto Care





-Post daily Stories to Instagram and

-Post Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts 4–5x per week

-Respond to comments and non-sales DMs daily

-Maintain and execute the PAC content calendar in Notion





Social Media — CEO Paradise (Personal Brand)



-Post Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts 3–5x per week

-Maintain and execute the CEO Paradise content calendar in Notion — separate identity, separate voice





Video Editing — CapCut





-Edit raw job footage into short-form Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts

-Add captions, text overlays, music, and transitions per brand guidelines

-Format and export correctly for each platform

-Edit technician talking-head videos and owner lifestyle/business content

-Build a simple video style guide for both brands in first 30 days

-Organize all finished content in Drive/Notion by brand and platform





Content Footage Pipeline





-Monitor shared Drive folder daily for new footage uploads from technicians

-Organize raw footage into Notion content library by brand, type, and status

-Move content through pipeline stages: raw ? editing ? ready to post ? posted

-Flag best footage to owner for approval before editing begins





 & General Admin





-Manage owner's
 inbox — filter, flag, organize, draft responses

-Handle vendor communication and follow-ups

-Research tasks as assigned

-Post-job review request and referral ask texts within 24 hours of every completed job







NON-NEGOTIABLE STANDARDS





Respond to new leads within 5 minutes during business hours — always

Be fully present and reachable during your 6-hour shift

Document every process you learn — if it isn't written, it doesn't exist

Never give pricing to leads — that is Mike's job on the call

Maintain two separate brand voices — PAC and CEO Paradise are not the same

Cross-check Urable before offering any time window to a lead

Deliver edits that are clean, on-brand, and ready to post — not drafts







THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR SOMEONE WHO:





Has never used a CRM and is not hungry to learn one fast

Has never used Notion or cannot build a workspace from scratch

Cannot operate CapCut at a basic to intermediate level

Needs to be told what to do every hour

Is slow to respond during work hours

Is managing multiple clients — we need full focus, full time

Uses passive language — "I try to," "I usually," "I think I can"

Has rated themselves five stars in every skill category on their profile

Has no ID or verification uploaded on their Onlinejobs.ph profile

Is looking for easy, low-responsibility remote work

Has no clear personal goals — urgency without goals is not sustainable







WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR





At least 2 years of VA, operations, or online business management experience

Proven Notion experience — you must be able to show us a workspace you built

CRM experience — you understand pipelines, stages, tags, and follow-up sequences

CapCut experience — you can edit a clean Reel with captions, music, and overlays

Professional, clear, warm English — clients and leads will be talking to you

Social media management experience across Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts

Systems thinker — you build the process, not just complete the task

Available and responsive during US Pacific Time hours

Someone with goals, drive, and a reason to perform at a high level







TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Urable — Scheduling and job management (training provided — must go deep)

Notion — Operations hub (must already know — you will build this)

Mailchimp —
 marketing

Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube — Both brands

Loom — Daily async communication with owner

Wise — Weekly payment

Slack — Communication & Team Updates







THE 40-DAY ONBOARDING WINDOW



Our current admin assistant is transitioning out in 40 days.



You will be trained alongside her before she leaves — learning the call setter role, the CRM pipeline, our systems, our voice, and our standards directly from her and the owner.



This means you must be hired and actively onboarding within the next 2-3 weeks.



After 40 days — this is entirely yours.



We are not filling a seat. We are handing over a role to someone who will own it, improve it, and make it better than it has ever been.





HOW TO APPLY



Every step below is required. Missing any step means your application will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Apply through this listing.



Step 2 — Answer all four questions in your cover message:





What CRM have you used and what specifically did you manage inside it?

Describe a Notion workspace you have built for a business — what did it include and what is the most advanced feature you used?

Tell us about a time you identified something broken or inefficient and fixed it without being asked.

A new lead texts in at 9:04 AM. It is now 9:11 AM and you have not replied. What do you do and why does those 7 minutes matter?





Step 3 — Record a 90-second Loom video and include the link.



In the video:





Introduce yourself — name, location, brief background

Screen share a Notion workspace you have built and walk us through it for 30–45 seconds

Show us a CapCut edit you have made — even 10–15 seconds of a finished video

Tell us one tool you went deep on for a previous employer and what you built or improved





No Loom = no interview. No exceptions.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT





We review every application personally

Top candidates receive a paid 2-hour skills test ($10 via Wise)

Finalists interview via video call with the owner

The right person starts within 1–2 weeks





We move fast. If you are the right person, you will know quickly.





We would rather stay understaffed than lower our standards.



Paradise Auto Care | Lake Elsinore, CA | 

Detailing with Purpose & Passion

title: Out sales agent - B2C
description:
Are you a high-energy, target-driven sales professional with exceptional spoken English and a passion for turning warm leads into customers? We are looking for an outstanding Outbound Sales Agent to join our growing remote team and help UK customers understand and book our professional surveying services.

This is a warm-highly competitive lead role ,you will be calling customers who have already completed an online price comparison form and expressed an interest in our services. There is no cold calling. Your job is to build rapport quickly, guide customers through our survey options, overcome objections, and close the sale.





Hours UK business hours: shifts start between 8:00am–9:30am (UK), finish between 4:30pm–6:00pm (UK)

Contract Full-Time

Reporting to Sales Director 

Tools Used HubSpot CRM | Contact Centre Dialler | WhatsApp |



What You Will Be Doing

• Calling warm leads — customers who have submitted an online price comparison enquiry for surveying services — no cold calling.

• Building genuine rapport with customers from the very first call, creating trust and confidence in our services.

• Clearly explaining our range of survey products, including the RICS Home Survey Standard, and how our regulatory framework protects customers.

• Confidently handling objections and turning hesitation into informed decisions.

• Providing accurate, tailored quotes to customers by phone,
, and WhatsApp.

• Closing sales on the call and guiding customers to make payment via a secure payment link.

• Maintaining detailed, accurate records of all interactions within HubSpot CRM.

• Working to and consistently achieving individual sales targets.

• Collaborating with the UK-based team to deliver an exceptional customer experience.



What We Are Looking For if you do not meet these please don't apply 

Essential:

• Outstanding spoken and written English — near-native fluency is essential for this role. We cannot consider applicants below this standard as you will be speaking directly with UK customers who communicate quickly and expect complete clarity and natural conversation.

• Proven experience in direct-to-consumer (B2C) sales, ideally selling to UK customers.

• A confident, persuasive telephone manner with the ability to build rapport fast.

• Strong objection-handling skills and a consultative approach to selling.

• Experience using a CRM system (HubSpot experience highly advantageous).

• Comfortable using a contact centre dialler and managing a busy call queue.

• Excellent listening skills — UK customers often speak fast and look for reassurance; you must be able to pick up on tone and respond naturally.

• Self-motivated, target-driven, and resilient under pressure.

• Availability to work UK business hours as specified above.



Preferred:

• Previous experience selling property, financial, or professional services to UK customers.

• Familiarity with the UK property market or surveying industry.

• Experience with WhatsApp as a customer communication and follow-up tool.



Home Office & Technical Requirements

This is a critical business role. Downtime is not acceptable. You must have a fully equipped, reliable home office set up before applying. We will provide all software and systems — you must provide the hardware and connectivity.

Required Equipment:

• Laptop/PC: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 5 equivalent

• RAM: 8 GB minimum

• Storage: 256 GB SSD minimum

• Operating System: Windows 11 (or fully supported Windows 10)

• Dual monitors: a second external screen is mandatory

• Ports: 1 × USB-A (for headset), 1 × USB-C (preferred), HDMI output (for external monitor)

• Quality USB headset with noise cancellation

• Primary internet connection: stable broadband, 20 Mbps or above

• BACKUP internet connection: a secondary broadband or mobile data connection is mandatory — connection failure cannot impact service delivery

• Backup power supply (UPS or equivalent) to protect against power outages — mandatory



??  Please note: applications will not be considered from candidates who cannot confirm they meet all hardware, connectivity, and backup requirements. This is a business-critical position and zero downtime is expected.



Workspace Environment:

• You must have a dedicated, quiet workspace ,a home office or a clearly defined area of your home that is free from background noise, interruptions, and disturbances.

• You will be speaking with UK customers on the phone throughout your shift. Any background noise, disruptions, or unprofessional environment is not acceptable.

• If you are successful and progress to interview stage, you will be asked to show your workspace on camera. We will assess whether your setup meets our standards before any offer is made.



????  If you do not meet all of the requirements above ,including English fluency, sales experience, technical specifications, backup connectivity, backup power, and workspace standards,  please do not apply. Due to the volume of applications, we are unable to respond to candidates who do not meet the full criteria.



How to Apply

Please apply with your CV and a short voice recording (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining why you are the right person for this role. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered, as English fluency is central to this position.



What to Expect — The Interview Process

If your application is shortlisted, the first-stage interview will include the following:

• Research task: you will be expected to arrive having researched House Smart Surveying and the UK property market. We will ask you questions on both. This is not optional — it demonstrates your initiative and genuine interest in the role.

• Role play exercise: you will take part in a simulated sales call so we can assess your English fluency, rapport-building, objection handling, and closing technique in a realistic scenario.

• Workspace review: if you progress through the interview, you will be asked to show your home workspace on camera. We will confirm it meets our requirements for quietness, professionalism, and technical setup before any offer is extended.



Candidates who prepare thoroughly for the interview consistently perform better. We want you to succeed , so do your research.

We look forward to hearing from outstanding candidates who are ready to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
